_comment: Reviewed high/critical advisories that the audit gate accepts. Each needs a reachability verdict, a link and an expiry. See docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md.

accepted.reason: Prototype pollution in SheetJS 0.18.5. No fixed version on npm. Reachable only through spreadsheet previews in a note; mitigated by client/src/utils/sheetRead.js (10 MB cap, row/sheet limits, prototype check, parse inside a Web Worker). Server never parses spreadsheets.
ReDoS in SheetJS 0.18.5. No fixed version on npm. Mitigated by the same file: parse runs in a Web Worker that is terminated after 20 s, so the page never freezes.
